title: Intrathecal methotrexate for GTN
context_label: Central nervous system prophylaxis in GTN
schedule_label: One spinal treatment every 14 days for three doses, with an oral rescue tablet the following day.
schedule_summary: The specialist team gives methotrexate into the fluid around the spinal cord. There are three treatments two weeks apart. The team coordinates appointments with your systemic chemotherapy. Take the single prescribed oral folinic acid tablet 24 hours after the spinal dose. If you also have a separate methotrexate course, ask the team to write down both rescue schedules. Call immediately about a missed or vomited tablet.
purpose: Reduce the risk of GTN involving the brain or the fluid surrounding the brain and spinal cord, alongside the systemic treatment plan.
indication_text: Prevention of central nervous system involvement in high-risk GTN or low-risk GTN with lung metastases.
administration_text: The specialist team gives methotrexate into the fluid around the spinal cord. There are three treatments two weeks apart. The team coordinates appointments with your systemic chemotherapy. Take the single prescribed oral folinic acid tablet 24 hours after the spinal dose. If you also have a separate methotrexate course, ask the team to write down both rescue schedules. Call immediately about a missed or vomited tablet.
monitoring_summary: Repeat blood count, kidney and liver tests. Check serum hCG on day 1, more often if indicated.
review_status: Feasibility build. Clinical, pharmacy and patient review pending.

agents.name: Methotrexate
agents.explanation: Prevents rapidly dividing trophoblastic cells using folate to make new DNA.

common_effects.title: How you feel between visits
common_effects.text: Tiredness, nausea or appetite changes can make everyday activities harder. Ask your team for help if symptoms interfere with eating or drinking.

serious_effects.title: Headache or neurological symptoms · Methotrexate
serious_effects.text: Seek urgent assessment for severe headache, fever, a stiff neck, new weakness, confusion or a seizure after spinal treatment.

serious_effects.title: Slower clearance · Methotrexate
serious_effects.text: Attend kidney blood tests. Report vomiting or difficulty drinking.

serious_effects.title: Rescue tablets · Folinic acid
serious_effects.text: Check each time against your written schedule. Phone about a missed or vomited dose.

evidence.interpretation: The Irish guideline describes prophylaxis alongside systemic therapy for the defined risk groups.
evidence.limitations: This is specialist guideline evidence. The benefit for an individual patient cannot be quantified from these recommendations.
